reviews.text: A very good experience with Les Trésors Pets. I took my dog ​​there, and everything went very well. Friendly welcome, gentle staff, and a really clean result. The appointment was perhaps a little long, but at least they took their time, and my dog ​​came out looking great. I'll be back.
Go for it, it's perfect. The welcome is exceptional.

Fantastic experience at Les Trésors Pets! The team is very professional and welcoming. I was perfectly informed and advised from the moment I arrived, and the grooming was done with great care. My dog ​​left looking impeccable and feeling completely confident. I recommend them 100%!

A beautiful, clean, bright, and very pleasant shop. The service is exceptionally attentive, both in terms of the products offered and the services provided.

The owner is very welcoming, attentive, meticulous, and thorough. He takes great care in grooming and cutting the dogs, with a high level of professionalism and care.

A wonderful shop in Les Halles that I highly recommend!
I brought my French bulldog, great salon, top-notch staff! I highly recommend it!
Horrible!!! I took my cocker spaniel there, they ruined his paws and left the fur on top. Terrible

A real gem of a place. It has everything: professionalism, excellent knowledge of the trade, and such a pleasant, caring atmosphere. The team is fantastic, and the owner is always looking for solutions to every problem. Great selection of products. Yes, it's pricey, but it's not like you're shopping at Animalis!

An excellent experience! The groomer was truly perfect: very professional, attentive, and gentle with the animals. The result is impeccable, exactly as I wanted. 🐶✨ A warm welcome, great kindness, and real expertise. I highly recommend them and will definitely be back. Thank you again!
Excellent experience for our Australian Shepherd! Thank you so much, the grooming is wonderful!

I came to this pet shop on the recommendation of other dog owners, and now I understand why it's so popular!

From the moment you arrive, you're greeted with a smile and genuine kindness. The manager is passionate, very professional, and takes the time to give real advice. You can immediately tell that he knows his business inside and out and that he truly loves animals.

The shop is beautiful: bright, modern, perfectly maintained, and spotlessly clean. There are no unpleasant odors, only a very pleasant fragrance that makes the place even more welcoming.

As for grooming, the team is simply exceptional. Every dog ​​and cat is treated with great gentleness, patience, and care. You can immediately see that the animals are in good hands and that they are respected and pampered.

One small detail that makes all the difference: after their bath, each animal leaves with delicious treats provided by the manager. A lovely touch that shows how much the well-being of the animals is a priority.

This is without a doubt one of the best pet shops I've ever come across. I leave my dog ​​there with complete confidence and I recommend this place without hesitation. Thank you again to the whole team for your professionalism and kindness!
